steps.title: Open the Today page
steps.narration: The market compass loads with the latest market state at the top, a plain-English summary, and all the key sections below.
steps.point_out: The page renders cleanly top to bottom: market-state band with regime and phase scores, summary card, and navigation chrome.

steps.title: Scroll to the Leadership rotation card
steps.narration: Below the What changed summary is a new Leadership rotation card that shows both directions—which sectors and themes gained ground and which lost ground this session.
steps.point_out: The card displays real, multi-colour content with two labelled columns: Gaining (left) and Losing (right), each showing rank changes with signed deltas and direction words.

steps.title: Read a Gaining sector example
steps.narration: In the Gaining column, you see sectors that improved—their ranking rose in the market, so they're gaining ground.
steps.point_out: An example row shows the sector name, a rank from → to, the signed delta in parentheses, and the word "improving" to indicate the direction.

steps.title: Read a Losing sector example
steps.narration: The Losing column shows sectors that weakened—their ranking fell, so they're losing ground. Each row shows the opposite direction word.
steps.point_out: An example row shows a positive signed delta and the word "deteriorating" to indicate the loss of ground.

steps.title: Scroll to Next-session focus candidates
steps.narration: Below the rotation section, the Next-session focus lists candidate stocks and ETFs that meet the selection criteria, with clear explanations of why each is or isn't eligible.
steps.point_out: The candidates show Leadership, Entry, and Risk labels. Each candidate displays a checklist of qualification criteria (Pass, Miss, Supportive, Neutral) and a what-would-change-this panel.

steps.title: Navigate to the Market page
steps.narration: The market surface shows the regime × phase cross-view, breadth trends, and deep dives into sectors and themes. Everything relocates intact and history remains honest.
steps.point_out: The sidebar navigation shows Today before Market, each page is highlighted correctly when active, and the market page displays glance cards, the regime × phase cross-view, and all category drilldowns.
